item_name: Rothco Swiss Wool Blanket With Cross
item_short_desc: Harness the power of natural warmth and protection with Rothco's Swiss Wool Blanket With Cross.
description: Harness the power of natural warmth and protection with Rothco Swiss Wool Blanket With Cross. This wool blanket features an embroidered red stripe cross making this military blanket not only functional but stylish too. Our Swiss blanket is constructed with a heavyweight yet breathable and comfortable 70% wool, 30% synthetic blend, designed to be fire-resistant and keep you warm and dry in the harshest of climates, major advantages for survival gear. The pico stitching around the edges of this outdoor blanket aids in rugged, long-lasting use. Rothco’s survival blanket in size 62 Inches x 80 Inches fits most cots. This durable and long-lasting emergency blanket is great for camping, backpacking, hunting, hiking or in survival situations.
